verses.text: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? Why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

verses.text: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast gotten of old, Which thou hast redeemed to be the tribe of thine inheritance; And mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

segments.text: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast gotten of old,

verses.text: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual ruins, All the evil that the enemy hath done in the sanctuary.

segments.text: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual ruins,
All the evil that the enemy hath done in the sanctuary.

verses.text: Thine adversaries have roared in the midst of thine assembly; They have set up their ensigns for signs.

segments.text: Thine adversaries have roared in the midst of thine assembly;

verses.text: They seemed as men that lifted up Axes upon a thicket of trees.

segments.text: They seemed as men that lifted up

verses.text: And now all the carved work thereof They break down with hatchet and hammers.

segments.text: And now all the carved work thereof

verses.text: They have set thy sanctuary on fire; They have profaned the dwelling-place of thy name by casting it to the ground.

verses.text: They said in their heart, Let us make havoc of them altogether: They have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

segments.text: They said in their heart, Let us make havoc of them altogether:

verses.text: We see not our signs: There is no more any prophet; Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

segments.text: We see not our signs:

verses.text: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

segments.text: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach?

verses.text: Why drawest thou back thy hand, even thy right hand? Pluck it out of thy bosom and consume them.

verses.text: Yet God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.

segments.text: Yet God is my King of old,

verses.text: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: Thou brakest the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters.

segments.text: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength:

verses.text: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces; Thou gavest him to be food to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

segments.text: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces;

verses.text: Thou didst cleave fountain and flood: Thou driedst up mighty rivers.

segments.text: Thou didst cleave fountain and flood:

verses.text: The day is thine, the night also is thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

segments.text: The day is thine, the night also is thine:

verses.text: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.

segments.text: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth:

verses.text: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Jehovah, And that a foolish people hath blasphemed thy name.

segments.text: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Jehovah,

verses.text: Oh deliver not the soul of thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast: Forget not the life of thy poor for ever.

segments.text: Oh deliver not the soul of thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast:

verses.text: Have respect unto the covenant; For the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of violence.

segments.text: Have respect unto the covenant;

verses.text: Oh let not the oppressed return ashamed: Let the poor and needy praise thy name.

segments.text: Oh let not the oppressed return ashamed:

verses.text: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: Remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee all the day.

verses.text: Forget not the voice of thine adversaries: The tumult of those that rise up against thee ascendeth continually.
